description: This file contains functions related to database compaction and traversal in the 'bbolt' package, including the 'Compact' function, walk utilities, and related types.

methods.name: Compact
methods.description: Creates a compacted copy of the source database into the destination database, managing transaction sizes and bucket creation.

methods.name: walk
methods.description: Recursively walks through the database, calling a callback function for each key/value pair.

methods.name: walkBucket
methods.description: Recursively traverses a bucket and its sub-buckets, invoking a callback for each key/value.
